Bengaluru Explosion Injures Two Workers

An explosion occurred at an under-construction building in Bengaluru, injuring two workers. One report states a device disguised as a torch exploded, causing a worker to lose two fingers. Another report describes the object as a mystery bag. An investigation is underway.
